# Corrections Pest Reference

> A free, primary-source reference to the pest control requirements that reach U.S. jails, prisons, and detention facilities. Every requirement is quoted from its source, with the source URL, a plain-language reading, who it applies to, the records that show it was met, and the date the text was verified. Maintained by Trenton S. Frazer, Board Certified Entomologist (BCE #B3413, Entomological Society of America Certification Corporation).

Use it to answer: what does a state's jail standard require for pest and vermin control; what federal detention standards (ICE, U.S. Marshals Service, Bureau of Prisons) require; what records show a jail responded to a pest grievance.

## Key pages

- [30-state comparison of jail pest standards](https://correctionspestreference.org/state-jail-standards/): the pest provision of each state's jail standards, side by side, quoted verbatim, with frequency, provider, and legal force.
- [Authority index](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/): every federal, state, local and association authority on the reference.
- [Pest Compliance Map](https://correctionspestreference.org/tools/compliance-map/): each requirement paired with the record that shows it was met, for federal detention standards and 30 states; filter by facility profile, download a PDF checklist per state, or export a spreadsheet.
- [Model Scope of Work](https://correctionspestreference.org/tools/scope-of-work/): model contract language for a correctional pest management scope of work, filled in for any of the 30 states on the reference, with a Word download for each state and a national version.
- [Model Pest Control Policy](https://correctionspestreference.org/tools/pest-control-policy/): model language for the written pest control policy many standards ask for, filled in for any of the 30 states on the reference, with a Word download for each state and a national version.
- [For Risk Pools and Insurers](https://correctionspestreference.org/risk-pools/): where pest grievance exposure lies in a member jail, three questions to ask, and the tools that answer them.
- [The Vermin Grievance File](https://correctionspestreference.org/tools/vermin-grievance-file/): the eight questions a pest grievance file must answer.
- [Grievance-to-Work-Order Loop](https://correctionspestreference.org/tools/grievance-loop/): a printable log tying each complaint to its work order and closure.
- [Methodology](https://correctionspestreference.org/methodology/): source tiers, confidence ratings, verification discipline, open questions.
- [About the author](https://correctionspestreference.org/about/): credentials and relationship to the author's practices.

- [Kentucky Jail Standards, 501 KAR 3:080](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/kentucky-501-kar-3-080-vermin-pests/)
- [Maryland Adult Detention Center Standards, COMAR 12.14.03.05](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/maryland-comar-12-14-03-05-vermin-pest-control/)

- [Minnesota Rules 2911.7500](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/minnesota-rule-2911-7500-vermin-pests/)
- [Montana Jail Standards (2016), Standard 10.01](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/montana-jail-standards-10-01/)
- [Nevada NAC 211.430](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/nevada-nac-211-430-vermin-control/)
- [New Jersey Adult County Correctional Facilities, N.J.A.C. 10A:31-11.5](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/new-jersey-njac-10a-31-11-5-vermin-pests/)
- [New Mexico Adult Detention Professional Standards SS-06](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/new-mexico-nmac-adps-ss-06/)
- [New York Commission of Correction, 9 NYCRR 7015.2(e)](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/new-york-9-nycrr-7015-2-insect-rodent/)
- [New York 9 NYCRR Part 7032, grievance program](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/new-york-9-nycrr-7032-grievance-program/): five days to file, a written determination in five business days, relief for all others similarly situated.
- [New York 10 NYCRR Subpart 14-1, food service insect and rodent control](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/new-york-10-nycrr-14-1-160-food-service-insect-rodent-control/): the State Sanitary Code rule for jail kitchens; New York has not adopted the FDA Food Code.
- [New York ECL Article 33 and 6 NYCRR Part 325, pesticide application](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/new-york-ecl-33-6-nycrr-325-pesticide-application/): certification, business and agency registration, label information, and records.
- [NYSSA Corrections Accreditation Standards 118 and 119](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/new-york-nyssa-corrections-accreditation-118-119/): monthly sanitation inspections; a kitchen free of rodents and insects.
- [North Carolina Jail Sanitation, 15A NCAC 18A .1515](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/north-carolina-15a-ncac-18a-1515-vermin-control/)
- [Ohio Adm.Code 5120:1-8-05](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/ohio-5120-1-8-05-jail-sanitation/)
- [Oklahoma Jail Standards, OAC 310:670-5-6(19)](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/oklahoma-oac-310-670-5-6-pest-control/)
- [ORS 169.076(2)(g) (Oregon)](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/oregon-ors-169-076-local-correctional-facility-standards/)
- [Oregon Jail Standards (OSSA), H-201 Sanitation Plan](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/oregon-ossa-jail-standards-h-201/)
- [Pennsylvania County Prison Requirements, 37 Pa. Code §95.248(2)](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/pennsylvania-37-pa-code-95-248-vermin-pests/)
- [South Carolina Minimum Standards for Local Detention Facilities, 3003](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/south-carolina-jail-standards-3003-vermin-insects-pests/)
- [Tennessee Corrections Institute, Rule 1400-01-.09(5)](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/tennessee-tci-1400-01-09-vermin-pests/)
- [Texas Minimum Jail Standards, 37 TAC §261.147](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/texas-tcjs-37-tac-261-147-vermin-control/)
- [Utah Correctional Standards (FY27 Secure Facilities) — Pest, Vermin, and Food Service Inspection](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/utah-udc-correctional-standards/)
- [Virginia 6VAC15-40-1150 — Jail Vermin and Pest Control (Quarterly Licensed Service)](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/virginia-6vac15-40-1150-vermin-pest-control/)

## Agency policy manuals

- [Lexipol Custody Manual Policy 805, Vermin and Pest Control](https://correctionspestreference.org/authorities/lexipol-custody-manual-policy-805-vermin-pest-control/): recorded by section from agency-published editions; a licensed pest control professional inspecting at least monthly.
